name: salesforce-pubsec-delivery
description: Requirements-to-deployment delivery pipeline for Salesforce Public Sector Solutions. Turns customer requirements into use cases, then a Public-Sector-aware Salesforce design, then runs a closed build-test-fix loop (GitHub + Jira + acceptance-criteria verification) that delegates metadata generation to the official forcedotcom/sf-skills and the dev loop to sf-dev-environment.
